summary: Question: Does the 2025 wellness stipend increase apply automatically?
description:
Issue summary:
Employee asking whether the 2025 wellness stipend cap increase requires re-enrollment or any action.

Context:
- People Ops announced a benefits/perks refresh in #announcements and via email.
- Handbook page referenced: confluence://company-handbook/03_benefits-and-perks/benefits-perks-update-2025

Question:
Does the increased stipend amount apply automatically starting 2025-02-01?
comments:
Monica Patel (People Ops): Confirmed — no re-enrollment. Same benefits portal and reimbursement flow; the annual cap updates automatically on 2025-02-01.

Naomi Feldman: Closing ticket. We’ll add a short Q&A line to the handbook page and point employees there.
resolution: Answered. No employee action required; stipend cap increases automatically effective 2025-02-01.
